name: DNS of turbulent open-channel flow at Re_tau = 250
model_or_instrument: Pseudospectral collocation / finite-difference DNS solver (Albertson & Parlange 1999)
access: Scripts and datasets generated as part of this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

scales.note: Dimensionless DNS open-channel flow (Re_tau = 250); SI length/time scales not defined. Size estimated for 6,000 snapshots of interpolated 128x128x64 grid with 3 velocity components in 32-bit float.
